description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_Encoder class, which provides static methods for UTF-8 string cleaning, encoding conversions, and character handling specific to HTML purification.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Encoder
classes.description: A static class providing UTF-8 string cleaning, encoding conversion, and character encoding support functions for HTML purification.

methods.name: cleanUTF8
methods.description: Cleans a UTF-8 string for well-formedness and SGML validity by removing invalid or control characters.

methods.name: unichr
methods.description: Converts a Unicode codepoint into its UTF-8 character representation.

methods.name: convertToUTF8
methods.description: Converts a string from a specified encoding to UTF-8, using iconv if available.

methods.name: convertFromUTF8
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to a specified encoding, with optional lossless ASCII conversion.

methods.name: convertToASCIIDumbLossless
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to ASCII with non-ASCII characters encoded as numeric entities.

methods.name: testEncodingSupportsASCII
methods.description: Tests whether a given encoding supports ASCII characters, returning a mapping of UTF-8 characters to ASCII equivalents.
